name: 97389 · Tangent, OR
findings: ZIP 97389 (Tangent) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97389 (Tangent) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
